verdict.rationale: Databricks documents Structured Streaming for continuous computation and Auto Loader for incremental processing of new files. It also documents Delta tables as streaming sources and sinks with exactly-once guarantees, a real-time mode with latency as low as 5 ms, and Lakeflow ETL pipelines that produce streaming tables and materialized views, all inside the platform. Missing for 10: independent or hands-on corroboration of the streaming and pipeline capabilities, and deeper evidence on declarative pipeline semantics (Lakeflow is described only briefly).

support.subject: As a data-engineer, I can run continuous or incremental transformations — streams, tasks, declarative pipelines, or continuous queries — inside the platform

citations.quote: Structured Streaming lets you express computation on streaming data in the same way you express a batch computation on static data.
Incrementally and efficiently process new data files as they arrive in cloud storage.
Use Delta Lake tables as streaming sources and sinks with exactly-once processing guarantees.
RTM processes records as they arrive, with end-to-end latency as low as five milliseconds.
Create and deploy an ETL (extract, transform, and load) pipeline for data orchestration using Lakeflow pipelines and Auto Loader.
which can be a Delta Lake table, streaming table, materialized view, or managed table
